note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, nineteen divisions, one member each. The Impartial Reporter of 4 May 1933, p. 5, reports the nominations: 'In the Irvinestown District there will be no contest. The following have been returned', with every division and member. Filed on 1933-05-31, the county's polling day that year (confirmed). Returned unopposed.
